MANUFACTURING INFRASTRUCTURE

Plant Infrastructure & Machine Capabilities

An exhaustive inventory of our high-precision CNC machinery, 6kW fiber laser cutters, fabrication bays, and climate-controlled metrology laboratory in GIDC Savli, Manjusar (Vadodara).

MANUFACTURING INFRASTRUCTURE

Advanced Machinery & Equipment Fleet

Housed in our dedicated facility at GIDC Savli, Manjusar (Vadodara), our modern CNC machine fleet and fabrication equipment enable tight-tolerance batch production and rapid turnarounds.

HIGH-SPEED MILLING

5-Axis / 4-Axis CNC Machining Centers

High-rigidity VMC equipped with linear scales and high-pressure through-spindle coolant for exotic alloys.

  • Travel (X/Y/Z)1,200 x 700 x 600 mm
  • Max Spindle Speed15,000 RPM (Direct Drive)
  • Tool Capacity30 Tools (ATC Twin Arm)
  • Positional Accuracy± 0.005 mm
6000W OPTICAL FIBER

6kW High-Power Fiber Laser Cutting System

Equipped with Precitec auto-focus cutting head, nitrogen assist high-pressure piercing, and dual exchange pallets.

  • Cutting Bed Area3,000 x 1,500 mm Dual Pallet
  • Laser Source6,000 W Solid-State Fiber
  • Max ThicknessMS 25mm | SS 20mm | AL 16mm
  • Repetitive Precision± 0.02 mm
150-TON HYDRAULIC

150-Ton Multi-Axis CNC Press Brake

Electro-hydraulic synchro press brake with Delem CNC graphics controller and automated hydraulic crowning.

  • Bending Capacity150 Metric Tons
  • Max Bending Length3,200 mm (10.5 Feet)
  • Backgauge Control4+1 Axis Multi-Axis CNC
  • Angle Accuracy± 0.25°
LIVE TOOLING LATHE

Heavy Duty CNC Turning Centers

Slant bed CNC lathes designed for heavy cutting of shafts, flanges, couplings, and precision bushing components.

  • Max Turning DiameterØ 450 mm
  • Max Turning Length1,000 mm Between Centers
  • Spindle BoreØ 80 mm Through-Hole
  • Runout Accuracy± 0.003 mm
CERTIFIED FABRICATION

Robotic & Certified TIG / MIG Welding Cells

Specialized welding bays equipped with argon purgers, motorized rotators, and ASME Sec IX certified welders.

  • ProcessesTIG (GTAW), MIG (GMAW), Spot
  • MaterialsSS 316, Hastelloy, Carbon Steel
  • Testing StandardsDye Penetrant, Hydrostatic, UT
  • Welder CertsASME Sec IX & EN ISO
QA & METROLOGY

Climate-Controlled CMM & Metrology Lab

  • CMM Accuracy0.001 mm (1 Micron)

METALLURGY & RAW MATERIAL SPECS

Engineered Alloys & Material Matrix

We stock and machine certified raw materials with 100% mill test certificates (MTC 3.1) and complete chemical & mechanical batch traceability.

SS 316LAUSTENITIC STAINLESS

Marine & Pharma Grade Stainless

Molybdenum-bearing austenitic steel offering superior corrosion resistance against chlorides and acids.

Machinability: Good (Rigid Setup)
Max Laser Cut: 20 mm (N2 Assist)
Weldability: Excellent (GTAW/GMAW)
Key Applications: Chemical Reactors, Marine Fittings, Impellers
SS 304 / 304LFOOD & INDUSTRIAL STAINLESS

Universal Corrosion-Resistant Alloy

The most widely utilized stainless alloy with excellent formability, oxidation resistance, and hygienic cleanability.

Machinability: Very Good
Max Laser Cut: 20 mm
Weldability: Excellent
Key Applications: Food Processing, Enclosures, SS Ducting
AL 6061-T6HEAT-TREATED ALUMINUM

High-Strength Structural Aluminum

Precipitation-hardened aluminum alloy containing magnesium and silicon. Superior strength-to-weight ratio.

Machinability: Excellent (High Speed)
Max Laser Cut: 16 mm
Anodizing: Superb Type II/III
Key Applications: Robotic Arms, Aerospace Brackets, Housings
AL 7075-T6AEROSPACE GRADE

Ultra High-Strength Aircraft Alloy

Zinc-alloyed aluminum delivering mechanical yield strengths comparable to many structural steels.

Machinability: Superb
Max Laser Cut: 12 mm
Tensile Strength: 572 MPa
Key Applications: Gears, Precision Shafts, Aviation Parts

Heavy Structural & Machinery Steel

Medium carbon and structural steel with predictable yield and great response to flame/induction hardening.

Machinability: Outstanding

High-Precision Turning Alloy

The industry benchmark for high-speed CNC turning with zero burr formation and mirror cosmetic finishes.
